_note: Runs executed by `mix eval.run`. Each run trains its own model on its own input, as a caller would. train.lambda may be a number or "oracle" (the true match rate among all pairs of the training file) to isolate prior-estimation error.

runs.name: enterprise_mpi
runs.description: Enterprise master patient index: every source in one file, deduplicated.

runs.name: enterprise_mpi_oracle_lambda
runs.description: Same as enterprise_mpi with the prior fixed to the true training-pair match rate, isolating prior estimation from comparison design.

runs.name: county_hospital_duplicates
runs.description: Duplicate-registration cleanup inside the safety-net hospital.

runs.name: hospital_a_x_county_hospital
runs.description: Health information exchange between a private system and the county system.

runs.name: county_hospital_x_fqhc
runs.description: Safety-net referral network: county hospital to community clinics.

runs.name: reference_lab_x_hospital_a
runs.description: Attaching outside lab results to hospital charts (thin, truncated lab demographics).

runs.name: pharmacy_x_payer
runs.description: Claims-to-dispensing reconciliation (nicknames vs legal names, SSN last-4 only).
